subject: Ephemeral service accounts, delegated admin & canary cutover plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@financorp.com>; security@financorp.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ephemeral service accounts, delegated admin & canary cutover plan

Hi Alice / FinanCorp security team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, I sketched a minimal rollout we think balances least-privilege controls with a low-risk cutover:

1) SCIM delta sync cadence: start with 1m delta window for a 48-hour dry-run (observe provisioning events), then widen to 5m for the canary cohort.
2) Ephemeral service accounts: issue short-lived service credentials (12h TTL) for the initial canary tasks; rotate via Redwood's ephemeral-token API.
3) Delegated admin mapping: create three scoped admin roles (onboard-admin, svcacct-provisioner, ip-ops) — documented in the attached role map.
4) IP allowlist: we will require CIDR-level entries for the first cutover; template attached. We'll support a managed reverse-proxy later in phase 2 for region-based routing.
5) Canary cutover plan: 10% tenants first, 30% after 24h, 100% after a successful 72h monitoring window. We include automatic rollback on auth error spikes.

Next steps I propose: you confirm SCIM delta tolerances and preferred TTL for ephemeral keys, and we schedule a 1-hour canary dry-run on Wed or Thu next week. I've attached the scim-delta spec and an IP template for your security team to review.

Attachments (stubs): scim-delta-window-spec.pdf (3 pages), ip-allowlist-templates.csv

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Solutions Engineer, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@financorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@financorp.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:01:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Ephemeral service accounts, delegated admin & canary cutover plan

Ben — thanks, this looks actionable. A couple quick clarifications from our InfoSec side:

> 1) SCIM delta sync cadence: start with 1m delta window for a 48-hour dry-run (observe provisioning events)

Is the 1m window safe if we have a backlog of changes? We want to avoid provisioning loops or transient duplicates. If you can include idempotency keys or a de-dup window in the spec that would help.

> 2) Ephemeral service accounts: issue short-lived service credentials (12h TTL)

12h is okay for the canary, but put a fallback path for emergency token revocation. Also include the audit event types we should expect for every issuance/rotation.

Attached: FinanCorp security questionnaire (small) — can you have your team fill the sections on audit logs and token revocation?

We are generally comfortable with the canary percentages but prefer the 10% cohort to be selected from non-production tenants.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Wong | Head of Platform Security, FinanCorp
security@financorp.com
Attachments referenced: financorp-security-questionnaire.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:27:45 -0800
Subject: RE: Ephemeral service accounts, delegated admin & canary cutover plan (internal ops checklist)

Internal notes / ops checklist for Ben's reply to FinanCorp and the canary dry-run:

- SCIM: implement idempotency header (X-Redwood-Req-Id) and retain a 2-minute dedup cache on our SCIM worker. Documented at PS-4042.
- Ephemeral tokens: default TTL = 12h for canary; provide immediate revocation endpoint and emit 'ephemeral.issued' and 'ephemeral.revoked' events to audit-stream (retain 90 days for FinanCorp).
- Delegated Admin: create RBAC mapping in delegated-admin-role-map.xlsx (attached) with least-privilege templates. Add an onboarding-only switch that disables provisioning for non-approved service accounts.
- IP Allowlist practice: we'll accept static CIDR entries initially; record all changes in an allowlist-change log with approver metadata. We should also add a webhook for 'allowlist-change' so FinanCorp can pull a change history during audits.
- Monitoring & rollback: set token error-rate alert at 0.5% absolute increase over baseline; automatic rollback to previous auth proxy config on sustained 3m error spike.

Operational timeline (proposed):
- Mon (prep): finalize role map, fill security questionnaire answers (Marissa to own).
- Wed 02:00-04:00 PT: 48h dry-run begins for SCIM with 1m window against sandbox tenants only.
- Fri: internal review, adjust TTLs if needed.
- Next Mon: 10% non-prod canary; 24h -> 30% staging-like tenants -> 72h -> full.

Links: Jira PS-4042, Drive runbook https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C-canary-plan

Marissa (cc Ben for external reply)
Marissa Cole | Director, Customer Success Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@financorp.com>, security@financorp.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:04:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Ephemeral service accounts, delegated admin & canary cutover plan

Alice — thanks for the quick review and the questionnaire. Short answers inline and next steps below.

- SCIM backlog and idempotency: we will add X-Redwood-Req-Id and a 2-minute de-dupe cache; the scim-delta-window-spec.pdf has the idempotency behavior now.
- Emergency revocation: we expose a revoke endpoint and will emit the 'ephemeral.revoked' audit event; retention 90 days, searchable from the Redwood Console.
- Cohort selection: confirmed — 10% non-prod only.
- Audit expectations: we will populate the questionnaire with events and retention details by EOD Monday (Marissa will send).

Proposed confirmed timeline:
- Mon 2026-11-23: Redwood to return completed security questionnaire + final role map (attachments: delegated-admin-role-map.xlsx).
- Wed 2026-11-25 02:00 PT: 48h SCIM dry-run on sandbox tenants (1m window).
- Mon 2026-11-30: 10% non-prod canary kickoff.

Attachments (stubs): delegated-admin-role-map.xlsx, canary-runbook.md

Please confirm the Mon/Wed schedule and we'll lock calendar invites. If FinanCorp needs a different timezone, propose an alternate and we will adapt.

Best,
Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
